architecture.design_tradeoff: Exact-type wrapper registration preserves explicit governed/local capability semantics without importing the outer governor into filesystem primitives or accepting arbitrary duck-typed wrappers.
architecture.implementation: Moved RemoteFiles into pure remote_files.py with original class identity reexports; LocalFiles/local_supported and exact-type confined-wrapper registry form the filesystem port; moved project confinement helpers to project_files.py so artifact_pages no longer imports the enclosing project reader. Existing confinement, GovernedFiles read/admit logic and remote behavior are preserved. Application readers import pure filesystem/cadence/text ports instead of UI/scheduler wrappers. Parent structural gate validates integrated graph.

compatibility_followups.issue: Cached evidence-log fixture was still injecting a UI accessor after application-reader port extraction.
compatibility_followups.resolution: Publish the same already validated entries in project_state.logs; preserve all no-manifest-reopen and evidence/fidelity assertions. No filesystem capability trust change.

compatibility_followups.issue: Shared structured accounting parser now rejects malformed restart counters before selected-detail collection.
compatibility_followups.resolution: Require fail-closed rejection at either earlier accounting publication or selected details, retaining no archive borrowing assertions.

compatibility_followups.issue: Allocation-only sacct requests could not replay released recordings without -X.
compatibility_followups.resolution: Narrow known-format read-only ReplayBackend alias removes only -X, keeps user/window/other arguments exact, preserves current-key/error/time precedence. Existing parser excludes step rows; native live allocation-only query unchanged.

compatibility_followups.issue: Cached ID lookup could hide an embedding adapter replacing one public row in place without changing list identity/size.
compatibility_followups.resolution: Validate requested row at its indexed source slot, rebuild only on replacement or a missing-ID lookup; never cache absence without source mutation tracking. Regression covers same-ID attempt correction and lookup-while-absent followed by same-length insertion of the previously absent ID.

compatibility_followups.issue: Anomaly fixture wrote under hand-inserted cached details without publishing fresh proof; interactive telemetry copy fixture had no scheduler port.
compatibility_followups.resolution: Explicit scheduler proof binding and an immediate test copy lane model existing production ports; all stale-attempt/notification/immutable-selection assertions retained.

design_tradeoffs.conclusion: Rejected: a legacy same-second requeue can falsely inherit verified ownership. Fresh publication proof or explicit session isolation is required.
design_tradeoffs.simpler_alternative: Reuse cached selected-job details for every append.

design_tradeoffs.conclusion: Rejected: memory grows with job duration. External ordered spool adds I/O/CPU (35k traced 3.75 to 7.31 seconds), reduces Python peak from 47.2 to 1.48 MB and process RSS from 144 to 22.5 MB (decimal MB), and preserves exact fidelity. The 60,001-row baseline refused rather than completing, so it is not a throughput comparison.
design_tradeoffs.simpler_alternative: Raise50k limit and retain one Python object for every input/output.

design_tradeoffs.conclusion: Use a size-derived finite allowance and cancellation-safe retry counting. Atomic stage restart remains simpler and avoids reconciling mutated source prefixes with partial CSV output.
design_tradeoffs.simpler_alternative: Raise failure retries or retain partly transformed stage offsets.

design_tradeoffs.conclusion: Rejected: SQLite may build sorter temporary files before returning rows. Reuse the bounded isolated child on every interpreter.
design_tradeoffs.simpler_alternative: Rely on row/VM limits inside the dashboard process.

design_tradeoffs.conclusion: Rejected: that conceals actual physical disk use. Retire only exact verified redundant inactive copies; protect active/pinned files and preserve raw values in compact storage.
design_tradeoffs.simpler_alternative: Ignore converted JSONL bytes in accounting.

items.implementation: Queue-counter identity and bounded exact legacy target verification; initial proven zero-counter promotion retains its history. Fresh queue-publication proof is required for verified writes. Deferred/ambiguous legacy samples remain separate session-only evidence while the prior graph remains visible. An explicit freshly verified retained-run binding authorizes its current queue publication; that authority expires on the next publication, preserving read-only same-scope coexistence without trusting a job number.

Compact and Light append paths roll back failed writes. Damaged suffixes are privately quarantined and synced before truncation; an atomic attempt-bound recovery descriptor persists the pending explicit gap through a failed append and a fresh process. Successful durable publication removes the descriptor. Light batches sync once.
Reverse-footer newest-window reader, explicit kept_end and unread byte coverage; corrupt suffix fallback remains an explicitly identified verified prefix.

Oldest inactive unpinned owned-attempt eviction, bounded candidate inventory with complete physical byte/file totals, exact duplicate-copy retirement, immediate pin protection and source health on refusal. Known stale session files and quarantined suffixes retire first; active/pinned raw attempts remain protected. A quota-full operational journal now yields space through bounded complete-line tail rotation or retirement before scientific eviction, respecting both byte and file caps. Recovery metadata is bounded, paired with its source, accounted as bytes and cleaned when orphaned.

Versioned compact telemetry rows share invariant index metadata; bounded rotating segments retain the newest data, record evicted counts and scale default budgets with time/device count. Local/remote readers and exports hydrate v2 and continue reading v1.

Adaptive median-cadence threshold with15s floor; bounded explicit gap omissions never claim missing gaps absent. SQLite ordered spool and streaming encoder/validator remove50k cliff with exact source-row provenance and decimal sums. Distinct gaps are not falsely merged across observed samples.

Size-aware bounded export allowance, cancellation preserves retry budget, reusable csv.writer per output. Chosen over resumable partially transformed sources to retain simpler atomic publication and source-integrity semantics.
Finite JSON writers separate torn final lines; migration/retention skip invalid rows with explicit counts; tail reader rejects nonfinite/deep malformed records.

Per-attempt readiness at256 queued samples or1s deadline, global memory pressure bound, shared existing writer lifecycle and forced close drain; one callback/sync per compact batch, fingerprint-invalidated verified-end cache.
Empty views do not enter retained-series LRU; bounded missing-read cache preserves check-once behavior; active histories share byte bounds without whole-history eviction.
read_path selects an existing compact recording else its JSONL original; advisor and storage maintenance use this reader routing independently of writer preference.
Transient ENOSPC/EDQUOT/EIO and retryable errors preserve family scheduling, row rollback and bounded retry; recovery also handles segment-creation failures.
Sampler alerts use render_snapshot, preserving existing rule behavior and avoiding recursive histories.

Publication-invalidated ID index serves job/record context; identity fast path reuses the captured identity before fresh write-authority checks. Each cached entry retains its source slot; O(1) slot validation detects same-length public-row replacement. Rare missing-ID lookups rebuild without caching absence because an embedding adapter can insert that ID in place without a mutation token. Valid per-sample lookups remain constant-time.
Recording identity/evidence/binding/proof/isolation maps prune against active, departed, retained finished and actual series ownership; bounded empty-view cache prunes unknown identities.
Complete captured-prefix SHA256 at preview/open, streamed measurement digest, post-stream hash and identity checks; old automatic plans refresh to the new watermark algorithm.

Passport hashes are explicitly corruption detection, not authorship authentication; existing independent signed-evidence namespace remains the authenticity workflow. No compatibility-breaking passport resigning is invented.
Manifest path/size/digest validated before path operations, maintaining controlled ValueError contract.
Optional SQLite load-extension disabling is guarded for builds without that method.
Telemetry data sync precedes fsynced index replacement and directory fsync; transient publication failures preserve retry.

Durable private export root, pinned nofollow component creation, exclusive0600 files and unique names. UI agent integrates clipboard atomic cache, log copy and bundle ports; MUT13 is the same underlying export issue.
Oversized first row returns bounded clearly truncated values plus original byte count/full UTF8 row digest; parent MCP layer advances cursor and reports partial coverage.
Evidence index v2 adds family/attempt/metric/timestamp/source_row ordering index; exact legacy catalog upgrades transactionally during ingest; v1 remains readable.
All SQL queries reuse isolated query-child path with private temporary directory,256MiB address-space, CPU/wall budgets and16MiB per-file sorter cap; extension/authorizer/VM protections remain.
Compensated rolling additions/removals and periodic bounded fsum rebasing retain small values after an extreme spike leaves.
Bulk tag publication and event persistence use shared coalescing writer port; default headless synchronous persistence remains.
Store started_seq is monotonic independently of bounded event deque; UI agent consumes it for bell behavior.
Empty chart cache and identity/proof pruning share DATA10/15 ownership; immutable start publication and cheap revision token support UI row-cache correctness.
pin_many resolves one uniform target for mixed selection and publishes/persists once; UI agent wires bulk action.
Same private durable export vulnerability and shared writer contract as DATA21.

performance_qualification: Controlled before/after synthetic measurements in review-data-benchmarks.json identify measured source hashes and clean baseline revision. Final recovery/quota audit and pure-port extraction happened afterward; no claim that those exact timings were remeasured on the final integrated revision. Harness source routing is reproducible; final integrated tests are coordinated by root. Process RSS and traced Python allocations are separate. Requested-slot validation and uncached rare missing-ID fallback were added during integrated regression afterward; no refreshed final-revision timing is claimed.
qualification_limits: No live GPU/real remote-cluster qualification is claimed by this package. Existing provider subprocess fixtures and isolated SSH helper tests validate contracts only. Parent coordinates live Slurm qualification.

Legacy scheduler targets beyond the bounded fresh-proof rotation retain session-only samples explicitly, never an invented exact-attempt attribution. Positive-counter initial ambiguous data is preserved separately.
Whole-prefix export integrity increases source I/O (preview/open/post and stream digest) to detect interior changes.
Compact newest-window readers validate the selected frames, not all older bytes; coverage explicitly reports unread older content.
Retention source/disk/CPU budgets still refuse operations that exceed declared finite limits, preserving original sources and previous publications.
A crash after committing a recovered gap and before deleting its descriptor may replay that same descriptive recovery_id once; sample frames remain checksummed and bounded.
scope: DATA-1..DATA-21; shared ANA-8/9/12/13, UI-8/10/11/13, MUT-13; S1 E filesystem/application reader seams
